label: exclusive-node series (authoritative)
methodology: One Slurm job, --exclusive, load average 0.58 at start; every tree measured back-to-back in the same job on the same node (r45), min of 7 wall runs each, source selected with PYTHONPATH against pinned worktrees. Cross-stage comparison is only meaningful this way -- the earlier per-stage numbers were taken on a shared node at wildly different load and overstated the later stages' cost.
